name: AiLinkAny
description: Connect AI assistants to explicitly authorized Windows PCs to manage files, run shell commands, use applications and check task status. Requires account OAuth, the AiLinkAny Windows client and a bound device. Computer execution needs an active subscription; device discovery and diagnostics do not. Select the intended PC when multiple devices are bound. Core service and Windows client are proprietary.
author: AiLinkAny
